title: When Multiple Choices Are Correct: Asymmetric Probability Allocation in Jev and Other Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29217v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models return normalized probability distributions over candidate choices, which downstream applications can use to select among choices. Although their providers emphasize the reliability of these probabilities, calibration on tasks with a single correct choice does not establish their reliability when multiple choices are correct. We evaluate three decision models (Jev, Liquid d1, and GPT-6 Luna Decisions) on three diverse datasets (MetaTool, HotpotQA, and ECtHR) to study probability allocation and thresholding. Even when models rank every correct choice above every distractor, in 28% to 50% of those lists, at least one correct choice receives a probability below the uniform probability of 1/n, where n is the number of choices. We also present each model with five identical copies of a correct choice and observe probability disparities, with mean gaps ranging from 17 to 79 percentage points. translated_title: 当多个选择都正确时：Jev及其他决策模型中的非对称概率分配
translated_abstract: 决策模型会返回候选选择上的归一化概率分布，下游应用可以利用这些概率在多个选择中进行筛选。尽管模型提供商强调这些概率的可靠性，但在单一正确答案任务上的校准并不能证明当存在多个正确选择时这些概率依然可靠。我们在三个多样化数据集（MetaTool、HotpotQA和ECtHR）上评估了三个决策模型（Jev、Liquid d1和GPT-6 Luna Decisions），以研究概率分配和阈值设定问题。研究发现，即使模型将所有正确选择都排在所有干扰项之上，在这些列表中仍有28%至50%的情况，至少有一个正确选择获得的概率低于均匀概率1/n（其中n为选择总数）。我们还向每个模型展示了同一正确选择的五个相同副本，观察到明显的概率差异，平均差距在17至79个百分点之间。我们进一步展示了这些分配不均……
tldr: 该论文通过在三个数据集上评估三个决策模型，首次系统揭示了多正确答案场景下概率分配的不对称性问题——即使模型排序完全正确，仍有28%至50%的案例中至少一个正确选择的概率低于均匀概率1/n，且给相同选项分配的概率差距高达17至79个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically reveals asymmetric probability allocation in decision models when multiple choices are correct—showing that even with perfect ranking, 28% to 50% of cases have at least one correct choice receiving below-uniform probability (1/n), with probability gaps of 17 to 79 percentage points among identical option copies.
